purpose: Connect an actual current user save instruction through a trusted runtime-owned port, without making Hermes clarify a business requirement.

ports.readCurrentRequest: The runtime owner independently retrieves the actual current user event and qualifies its intent and exact admitted scope. New or cancelled instructions hold execution. Tool arguments, caller approval flags and a saved provenance document cannot supply this port.
ports.consumeOnce: Durable exclusive creation and fsync before dispatch. The stable identity binds runtime, actual request, exact target, effect record, field and proposed value; caller-selected attempt IDs and output paths cannot renew consumption.

preservedChecks: exact owned student/date/current and previous record
qualified source wire and literal options
independent source readback and unchanged-field checks
legacyCompatibility: harness/academy_journal_http.ts retains its Hermes-specific adapter. Its clarify lookup is not a requirement of the generic source action guard or the new runtime-owned port. No native session database, engine configuration, approval policy or credential getter is rewritten.
scope: No source save, current user authority, credential access, parent send, global registration or deployment is granted by this document. Runtime operation receipts remain private outside the source repository.
